positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and how was it confirmed?
positions.why: src-1 and src-3 both assert the same calibration value (88.4 MHz) — once in prose, once as a structured field — and src-2 and src-4 both assert the same verification method (checked against June reference plates, holding across the full band) in the same two formats. Read together, the prose narrative and the structured summary are two renderings of one calibration event, so the frame reads all four as describing the single verified state of the instrument rather than as separate claims.
